declaration.purpose: Run Strategy H's frozen D2->D6 research on new material evidence and on new candidates without a manual step, inside a code-enforced cost and safety contract, and hand the decision to the existing H paper book.
declaration.research_build: CLOSED (this contract re-runs frozen modules; it adds no rule, threshold or model step)

revision.what: new-candidate intake wired to production sources (A's reference/grouped/splits stores read-only, H's own reference refresh, SEC on demand), code-owned MethodJudgement for issuers outside the frozen tables; budget, priority, retry, model and D5 contract unchanged

stages.ledger_writer: app.strategies.h_forward.transitions (record for cohort members, admit for new candidates)
stages.d2_refresh_trigger_inclusion: after the frozen materialize_candidate, every REFRESH_DUE trigger accession the package did not chunk is materialised from its primary document with materialize._materialize_source (role REFRESH_TRIGGER) and appended; a trigger that still has no chunk makes the item DATA_NOT_READY:NEW_EVIDENCE_NOT_MATERIALIZED before any model call. Found 2026-10-13: FG 8-K 0001934850-26-000095 has no EX-99 (text in the primary document) and VRRM 8-K 0001193125-26-412497 lost its CORE 8-K slot to the 8-K/A 0001193125-26-413031

model.mismatch_action: FAILED:MODEL_CONTRACT_VIOLATION, nothing written to the forward ledger, no queue retry

budget.reservation_basis: contract worst case: D3 3 calls x $2.00 + D4 3 calls x $2.00 (per-call --max-budget-usd cap, initial + 2 repairs each)
budget.admission_rule: a candidate starts only while (daily hard budget - spent today - open reservations) >= reservation AND (operator cumulative cap - spent since authorization) >= reservation AND candidates started today < max_research_candidates_per_day
budget.over_budget_status: BUDGET_DEFERRED (kept in the queue, never dropped)
budget.day_boundary: America/New_York calendar date of the run

observed_cost_basis.source: every stored D3 attempt (data/runtime/strategy_h_v2/d3_3/attempts) and D4 analysis (d4_1, d4_2, d4_b, d4_br_c)
observed_cost_basis.why_reservation_is_not_the_median: the reservation is the contract-bounded worst case, so a candidate admitted under it cannot overrun the daily cap; the medians only predict spend (about $3 per candidate)

authorization.absent_means: RESEARCH_NOT_AUTHORIZED: the queue is built and kept, no model call is made

priority.P0: REFRESH_DUE whose new filing is earnings or guidance: 10-Q, 10-K, or an 8-K carrying item 2.02
priority.P1: any other material REFRESH_DUE (8-K without 2.02, e.g. 5.02, 7.01, 1.01)
priority.item_7_01_alone: P1: Reg FD material may or may not be guidance and no code reads its text before research, so it is not promoted
priority.tie_break: earliest new filing date (refresh) or intake order (new candidate), then ticker; never a return, a price or a forward outcome

evidence_dedup.frozen_thesis_index: docs/operations/h_thesis_evidence_v1.json (chunked accessions of each T1 package)
evidence_dedup.runtime_thesis_index: <H forward store>/auto/thesis_evidence.jsonl (append-only, one row per completed re-evaluation)
evidence_dedup.in_thesis_when: the accession was chunked into the package the thesis read, OR it is listed in that thesis bundle's filings, OR (runtime theses only) its filing date is on or before the date the thesis bundle's submissions were current
evidence_dedup.action: EVIDENCE_ALREADY_IN_THESIS: not queued for research, no model call; historical states and documents are not rewritten

retry.retry_not_before: the next daily run (never in the same run)
retry.model_schema: the stage's own bounded repair loop only; SCHEMA_VALIDATION_FAILED is terminal FAILED
retry.forbidden: re-running a completed item because its decision is unwelcome

queue.store: <H forward store>/auto/queue_events.jsonl (append-only; the current queue is the fold of its events)
queue.stale_running: an item left RUNNING by a crashed run is closed as FAILED:INTERRUPTED with its spent cost and becomes retryable under the infra rule

new_candidate_intake.pipeline: production reference universe -> E1 eligibility -> E2 change detection -> E3 priority (assemble_candidate, unchanged), no model call; the scan runs in usb-h-research (SCAN) after the gate in usb-h-forward (GATE)

requires: reference snapshot in force for the publishable session no older than reference_snapshot_max_age_days, with active US common-stock rows carrying a CIK
A's grouped store holds the publishable session (previous XNYS session of now)
A's grouped store holds at least 252 sessions
fundamentals are not gated here: each issuer's SEC facts are fetched on demand and must be at most sec_on_demand.max_age_days old when it is scanned
freshness_gate.fail_action: NEW_CANDIDATE_SCAN = DATA_NOT_READY with reasons; new_candidates.json untouched; existing cohort refresh, prices, outcomes, paper NAV and exits keep running

new_candidate_intake.d5_method_judgement: a cohort issuer is valued through the frozen tables (run_strategy_h_v2_d6.METHOD_JUDGEMENTS); any other issuer gets H_METHOD_JUDGEMENT_AUTO_V1 (h_auto.method_judgement): primary = ECONOMICALLY_REASONABLE methods and secondary = SECONDARY_ONLY methods of multiples.method_suitability (D5-D0 section 17, MIN_MARGIN_FOR_PRIMARY 2%, MATERIAL_NET_DEBT_SHARE_OF_EV 10%) on the decision session's IssuerSession, in METHOD_ORDER; P/B withheld (its applicability must be argued per issuer); unsuitable empty (NOT_SUITABLE is AI-owned); a financial issuer (SIC 6000-6799), an unresolved SIC, no computable multiple or no ECONOMICALLY_REASONABLE method is DATA_NOT_READY:METHOD_JUDGEMENT_NOT_READY before any model call
new_candidate_intake.admission: a decision-eligible D6 result is appended with cohort_tag NEW_FORWARD_CANDIDATE (APPROVE, WATCH and REJECT alike); NOT_DECISION_ELIGIBLE is not admitted
new_candidate_intake.intake_order: E3 P1_HIGH before P2_MEDIUM, then fewest days since the latest SEC filing (evidence recency, not price), then ticker; candidates beyond the open-item cap wait for the next scan
new_candidate_intake.excluded: any ticker already in H's forward ledger (it is refreshed, not admitted)

production_sources.active_universe: newest CS reference snapshot on or before the publishable session: Strategy A's data/runtime/strategy_c/raw/tickers (read-only) or H's own auto/reference/CS_<as_of>.json.gz fetched daily with strategy_c_selection.raw_fetch.fetch_tickers (A's fetcher, A's format, H's directory)
production_sources.ticker_cik: the cik field of that snapshot row (strategy_c_e0.cik_map rule: newest as_of <= session); ticker text is never the join key
production_sources.daily_prices: Strategy A's data/runtime/strategy_c/raw/grouped/<session>.json.gz (Massive grouped daily, unadjusted, usb-grouped-daily 00:40 ET), read-only
production_sources.historical_lookback: every session in A's grouped store; at least 252 sessions required (E1 MIN_TRAILING_SESSIONS 60, price_context 252, executor check_panel 252, D5 RECENT_12M 252)
production_sources.split_adjustment: none (unadjusted store); A's data/runtime/strategy_c/raw/splits execution dates feed the frozen D1 dilution check
production_sources.fundamentals: SEC submissions (from 2022) and companyfacts per CIK on demand through sec_store/xbrl_store into auto/sec/<ET day>/ (h_auto.facts_cache); the research-frozen full-universe store (strategy_h_v2/d1_1) is not a production source
production_sources.not_production: research_universe_u1 CS_2024-10-25, strategy_b_e0 HIST-V1 mirror (ends 2026-09-16), strategy_h_v2/d1_1 companyfacts (fetched 2026-09-28)

sec_on_demand.order: market-passing CIKs with no cached copy first (by CIK), then stale copies oldest first (by CIK); never by a price or a return
sec_on_demand.market_tier_first: E1's market tier (>= 60 stored sessions, latest close >= $1, 21-session ADV >= $1M) is read from A's grouped store before any SEC call; a row that fails it is INELIGIBLE or DATA_NOT_READY whatever its fundamentals say, so no SEC request is made for it
sec_on_demand.scan: E1->E3 runs on the rows whose facts were (re)fetched; results are folded into auto/intake_index.json and new_candidates.json lists index rows with fresh facts, E3 P1/P2, within max_age_days of their scan
sec_on_demand.measured_basis: measured 2026-10-14 on the local tree against SEC with production reference/prices: 700 CIKs (submissions + companyfacts, 1,406 requests) in about 10 minutes, scan peak RSS 286 MB; 3,130 market-passing CIKs at 700 per weekday run are each refreshed every 5 runs (7 calendar days), the freshness bound; keeping every P1/P2 body measured 337 MB for 2,000 CIKs, so only written candidates keep bodies
sec_on_demand.after_scan: compact: bodies of every CIK not in new_candidates.json are deleted, request ledgers kept (freshness unchanged; a missing body is refetched when next planned; the executor fetches its own copy)

new_candidate_intake.method_judgement_screen: before new_candidates.json is written, the intake walks the contract order and keeps the first (10 - open items) candidates whose H_METHOD_JUDGEMENT_AUTO_V1 verdict on the publishable session's D5 panel is AUTO_READY; a ticker that already has a NEW_CANDIDATE queue item is never written again; verdicts are stored in auto/intake_index.json and reused while the issuer's SEC facts day is unchanged; at most 40 new verdicts per run. Reason (measured 2026-10-14): 19 of 30 current candidates are METHOD_JUDGEMENT_NOT_READY and, written unscreened, would have held the 10 open slots indefinitely

daily_order: 4 new candidate intake: GATE (reference snapshot refresh + freshness gate) in usb-h-forward; SCAN (SEC on demand + E1->E3) at the start of usb-h-research
7 decision transitions (written by research, read here)

failure_domains.soft: steps 2-6 fail into their own status; steps 1, 8 and 9 still run
